strategies.name: Competitive Pricing · Packaged snacks

operating_tradeoffs: Thin unit margins leave little room for shipping or fee increases.
Marketplace commissions and ad auctions can erode contribution quickly.
Food compliance: FSSAI registration/licence, labelling and shelf-life planning are required before launch.
advantages: Lower price barrier for first purchase.
Easy to communicate value against visible competitors.
disadvantages: Vulnerable to price wars and promotions by incumbents.
